title: Transaction ownership and depth cleanup
execution_label: independent review execution on the pinned prepared tree
scope_check: Restoring only _write/_read makes the entire production module AST identical to the pinned baseline.
compatibility: Preserves successful nested borrowing, opaque return identity, ordinary callback errors, cleanup exception precedence and existing read rollback behavior; only a successfully begun transaction is owned.
execution_scope: AST _write/_read only; fake lock/depth/connection execute/commit/rollback and opaque callbacks. No target module import, constructor, real SQL/database, domain helper, receipt, evidence, identity, archive, network or model.
limits: Fake transaction/depth/cleanup behavior only; not real SQLite locking, cross-thread recovery or all asynchronous signal windows.
Cleanup failure remains visible and may leave a transaction open; resetting depth does not claim rollback succeeded.
Older35 runtime cases excluded; JS015 byte cases not rerun in this Python checkpoint and remain separately counted.
No domain SQL, receipt, archive, identity, authorization or evidence operation executed or changed; full suite/production unverified.
test_counting: Repeated before/after/regression executions do not add distinct tests. These prepared-tree totals are separate checkpoints and must not be summed. JavaScript byte cases remain separate from Python test methods. No full-suite or production pass is claimed.
